name: Anonindo Conflict Detector
author: Akshay Vasoya

sections.description:
Anonindo Conflict Detector is a powerful debugging tool designed to help WordPress users quickly identify plugin conflicts and fatal errors.

Instead of manually disabling plugins one by one, this plugin automates the process using intelligent detection methods.

Whether you’re a developer, agency, or site owner, this tool helps you diagnose issues faster and safer.

🚀 Key Features

✔ Detect plugin conflicts automatically
✔ Binary search-based conflict detection (fast & efficient)
✔ Plugin pair conflict testing
✔ Fatal PHP error logging system
✔ Safe Mode to instantly disable all plugins
✔ Clean and user-friendly dashboard
✔ No external API calls (100% local & secure)

🧠 How It Works

The plugin uses multiple detection strategies:

🔹 Basic Scan

Scans individual plugins for recorded errors.

🔹 Binary Detection

Quickly narrows down conflicting plugins using divide-and-conquer logic.

🔹 Pair Detection

Finds specific plugin combinations causing issues.

🔹 Error Logging

Captures fatal PHP errors and links them to plugins.

🛡️ Safe Mode

Safe Mode allows you to:

✔ Disable all plugins instantly
✔ Recover broken websites
✔ Debug safely without FTP access

Use it when your site crashes or becomes inaccessible.

📊 Use Cases

Perfect for:

  • Developers debugging plugin conflicts
  • Agencies managing multiple WordPress sites
  • Site owners facing white screen or fatal errors
  • WooCommerce troubleshooting
  • Plugin compatibility testing

🔒 Privacy & Security

✔ No data collection
✔ No external API requests
✔ All scans run locally
✔ Fully secure and WordPress-compliant

⚙️ Installation

  1. Upload the plugin to /wp-content/plugins/
  2. Activate the plugin via the ‘Plugins’ screen
  3. Navigate to Conflict Detector in the admin menu
  4. Start scanning plugins

❓ Frequently Asked Questions

Will this plugin modify my site data?

No. It only reads plugin behavior and logs errors.

Can I use this on a live site?

Yes. However, Safe Mode disables plugins temporarily, so use it carefully.

Does it slow down my website?

No. It runs only when you initiate scans.

Does it support all plugins?

Yes, it works with any WordPress plugin.

Does it send data anywhere?

No. Everything stays on your server.

📸 Screenshots

  1. Dashboard interface
  2. Plugin scan results
  3. Conflict detection output
  4. Safe mode activation

🧪 Developer Friendly

  • Built using WordPress Coding Standards (WPCS)
  • Fully Plugin Check compliant
  • Secure database handling
  • Extensible architecture for future enhancements

🛠️ Roadmap

Upcoming features:

  • Automated conflict detection (WP-Cron)
  • Email alerts for errors
  • Export reports (CSV / PDF)
  • Advanced debugging insights
  • Pro version with extended tools

🤝 Support

If you find any issues or have suggestions, feel free to reach out.
